senses.gloss: stocks, an instrument of torture in the shape of a wooden collar.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 20:2">Targ. Jer. XX, 2</cite>, sq.; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 29:26">ib. XXIX, 26</cite> (h. text <he>מהפכת</he>, which Rashi explains by <he>כיפה</he>).
